versions.description_html:
Learn how Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager turns messy compliance questions into a single score. Understand assessments, templates, and actions.

There's a question that makes most companies go quiet, and it's the one about whether they're actually compliant. Compliance Manager lives inside Microsoft Purview, and it takes that messy question and turns it into a single number you can watch move.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Compliance Manager Is
  • The Compliance Score
  • Assessments
  • Regulations and Templates
  • Improvement Actions
  • Who Does What
  • The Workflow End to End
  • A Quick Recap and One Open Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • Communication Compliance - Simply Explained
  • Azure Governance Architecture to Control Cost, Security, and Compliance
  • More Microsoft Security episodes on M365.FM
